note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number exist for 2026-02-28 (Uruguay, Nepal x2, South Africa, Mexico), all agricultural tractors under HS 87019200/87019300. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: the declared HS in the batch is 848299 (parts of bearings), but every observed shipment line is HS 8701 (tractors) - per project rule 3 this is NOT a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the factual code should be corrected to 8701 (tractors), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Also note the claimed industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy/mining) does not match the observed product flow (agricultural tractors); CNH Industrial is an agricultural/construction equipment manufacturer, so the industry label should be corrected too. Role: manufacturer (own plant at Plot No 3, Udyog Kendra Industrial Area, Greater Noida per ImportYeti address block), not a trader. Domestic supply evidence is genuinely missing rather than negative: registries and tender portals were blocked (403/429) and the search backend was offline, so domestic_status is 'unknown', not 'none_found' - absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales.
